product: a B2B security web app (an AI-assisted SOC)
serve: corepack pnpm build:mock && corepack pnpm exec vite preview --mode mock --outDir dist-mock --port {port} --strictPort
glossary: German addresses the reader formally ("Sie"), Spanish too ("usted").
The product is "the AI SOC" (de "der AI SOC", es "el AI SOC").
Workspace: de "Workspace", es "espacio de trabajo". Finding: de "Finding", es "hallazgo". Case: de "Fall", es "caso".
Role names are roles, not people: de "Analyst", "Betrachter", without gender forms.
Internal names (SOC core, queue subjects, raw slugs, IDs) never appear in texts.
sampleData: titles of cases and findings, names of people, customers, workspaces, sites and devices, hostnames, IP addresses, counts, dates and times of events
staysEnglish: AI SOC, Workspace (German), Finding (German), Status (German), STIX, MITRE, ATT&CK
